head.text: WF-022 - T1 update blocked, T2 owner cancel escapes (abstract event order)

foot.text: Columns are ordered event phases, not clock cycles. T1 keeps UPDATE VALID while it is ineligible and READY remains low. The matching reservation-owner T2 CANCEL is accepted independently and releases the set reservation. T1's unchanged UPDATE then handshakes. This illustrates the selected CC-01 escape and makes no cycle-latency claim.
